rows.notice:
ผู้ป่วยโรคไตเรื้อรัง หมายถึง ผู้ป่วยจากแฟ้ม DIAGNOSIS_OPD ที่มีรหัสโรคเป็น (N181-184, (N189 ที่ไม่มี eGFR หรือมี eGFR>=15)) หรือ ( (E102, E112, E122, E132, E142 หรือ I12*, I13*, I151) ที่มี eGFR>= 15 )
********* ผู้ป่วย 1 คน จะมีเพียง 1 Record จากการตัดความซ้ำซ้อนด้วยเลขบัตรประชาชนและ Typearea ******

การแบ่ง Stage แบ่งจากค่า cretinine ครั้งสุดท้ายที่แปลงเป็น egfr /egfr ครั้งสุดท้ายที่ตรวจ ตามช่วงดังนี้
- stage 1 >= 90
- stage 2 = 60-89.99
- stage 3 = 30-59.99
- stage 4= 15-29.99
- stage 5 น้อยกว่า 15

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("stage1"+"stage2"+"stage3"+"stage4"+"stage5") allstage ,SUM("stage1") as "stage1" ,SUM("stage2") as "stage2" ,SUM("stage3") as "stage3" ,SUM("stage4") as "stage4" ,SUM("stage5") as "stage5" FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

service_plan.label: Service plan
service_plan.query: SELECT h.splevel as a_code ,h.splevel as a_name ,  SUM(stage1+stage2+stage3+stage4+stage5) allstage ,SUM(stage1) as stage1 ,SUM(stage2) as stage2 ,SUM(stage3) as stage3 ,SUM(stage4) as stage4 ,SUM(stage5) as stage5 FROM (SELECT * FROM ccmihosp WHERE byear={{YEAR}}) as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hcode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} JOIN chospital as c ON c.hoscode = h.hcode WHERE (c.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (c.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (c.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (c.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (c.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (c.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (c.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (h.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(regbed AS DECIMAL) DESC
